goal5743.title: Quadratische Funktionen aus Punkten oder Bedingungen bestimmen
goal5743.titleEn: Determine quadratic functions from points or conditions
goal5743.description: Die lernende Person kann lineare Gleichungssysteme mit drei Unbekannten nutzen, um Koeffizienten quadratischer Funktionen aus Punkten oder Bedingungen zu bestimmen, und das Verfahren algorithmisch erläutern.
goal5743.descriptionEn: The learner can use systems of three linear equations to determine coefficients of quadratic functions from points or conditions and explain the procedure algorithmically.

negativePowerGoal.title: Potenzen mit rationalen Basen und negativen Exponenten deuten und berechnen
negativePowerGoal.titleEn: Interpret and compute powers with rational bases and negative exponents
negativePowerGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Potenzen mit rationalen Basen berechnen, negative ganzzahlige Exponenten als Kehrwertschreibweisen deuten und Darstellungen sehr kleiner Größen mit negativen Zehnerpotenzen in Sachzusammenhängen interpretieren.
negativePowerGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compute powers with rational bases, interpret negative integer exponents as reciprocal forms, and interpret representations of very small quantities using negative powers of ten in contextual situations.

positivePowerGoal.title: Potenzen mit natürlichen Exponenten deuten und berechnen
positivePowerGoal.titleEn: Interpret and compute powers with natural exponents
positivePowerGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann bei Potenzen a^n mit ganzzahliger Basis a und natürlichem Exponenten n ≥ 1 Basis und Exponent unterscheiden, a^n als Produkt aus n gleichen Faktoren deuten, den Wert berechnen und das Ergebnis an der Faktorstruktur prüfen.
positivePowerGoal.descriptionEn: For powers a^n with integer base a and natural exponent n ≥ 1, the learner can distinguish base and exponent, interpret a^n as a product of n equal factors, calculate its value, and check the result against the factor structure.

didacticVerdict: The complete negative-integer-exponent contract is not general preparation for any of the four unchanged simple-variable/term/linear-equation contracts. Remove exactly these four direct demands; this is independent of endpoint counts.

wholeConsumerReasons.325771e1-602d-4bca-a199-a8f39a2d3dee: Equivalent transformations, solving and checking linear equations require ordinary rational arithmetic and terms; negative exponent notation is not intrinsic to linearity. A possible advanced coefficient notation is not a general prerequisite.
wholeConsumerReasons.fd860da9-73ba-47cd-a1a8-452424915a80: Building terms for simple situations and explaining variable meanings does not require reciprocals written as negative powers or scientific notation.
wholeConsumerReasons.5bba4ec2-3781-4624-8b62-e24b38f7f76e: Choosing variables and describing simple dependencies is prior to any special negative-exponent notation, not dependent on it.
wholeConsumerReasons.c9112f89-ffaf-40f3-af1f-86a04b5ad4ee: Distinguishing unknown, varying quantity and parameter can be learned on elementary linear terms/equations; whole negative powers are not necessary preparation.

concreteLaterAcquisition.fact: Natural, integer and rational exponents are placed in year10; desired quadratic reconstruction is in year9 after9.1 LGS and9.3 quadratics.
Negative integer exponents are explicitly introduced in year10, after the year9 LGS/optional three-variable and quadratics corridor.

necessaryPositivePowerPreservation.rationale: The defining quadratic term x^2 actually needs understanding and evaluation of natural powers; keep this existing genuine preparation explicitly at 5743 when removing the overbroad detour. No new goal or mastery identity. Large-number scientific notation and negative powers are not needed by the whole quadratic reconstruction contract.

candidateGate: Later independent implementation must recompute effective inherited/direct preparation, every actual PC context/demand and any newly exposed ordinary endpoints. The didactic removal must not be reversed merely to keep counts green. No current all161 after-result is claimed.
